title: Red Wagon Memory
description: A bearded man in a grey t-shirt sits inside a large red Radio Flyer wagon holding a vintage lantern, while a smiling blonde woman in a long black dress pulls the wagon along a dirt path. The surreal grassy landscape is scattered with numerous smaller red wagons, detached red wheels, miniature chairs, and tiny lit lanterns under a pastel sunset sky.
prompt: A surreal pastoral scene at dusk showing a bearded man sitting in an oversized red Radio Flyer wagon holding a glowing lantern while a smiling blonde woman in a flowing black dress pulls him along a winding dirt path through a grassy field. The landscape is filled with many smaller red wagons, detached red wheels, miniature red chairs, and tiny lit lanterns scattered across the meadow with purple wildflowers. Soft pastel sky with hints of sunset, realistic painting style with dreamlike atmosphere.
